text: The Experiment permissions follow-up updates aboutAddonsExtra to webext-perms-description-experiment-access. The fixed renderer creates the list item and its document loads messenger/extensionPermissions.ftl, which defines that ID. The inspected extension-install task checks the same ID in another prompt, so it does not directly assert the about:addons permission renderer. Preserve that coverage distinction when reusing the test. No console or UI run occurred.
